errors.evidence: The labels on the x-axis are 'Accounting', 'Certificate', 'Economy', 'Finance', and 'AVG'. These are not in alphabetical order because 'AVG' breaks the sequence.
The description states that the vertical axis represents 'performance score' (性能得分), but the y-axis has no label in the figure.
The description claims the unit of the y-axis is percentage, but no unit is specified on the axis in the figure.
In the 'Accounting' category, both bars are nearly identical in height and are at approximately 68, not 67 and 66.
In the 'Certificate' category, the 'Utility' bar is clearly above 70 (approx. 71) and the 'Random' bar is at approximately 70. The stated values of 69 and 68 are significant underestimates.
In the 'Finance' category, the 'Random' bar (approx. 69) is visibly taller than the 'Utility' bar (approx. 68). The description incorrectly states they are both approximately 67.
In the 'AVG' category, both bars are nearly identical in height and are at approximately 68, not 67 and 66.
